name: Sync new user from Zendesk to NetSuite
description:
1. A new user is created in Zendesk. 

2. Workato searches for a matching contact in NetSuite by **email address**. 

3. If no matching contact is found in NetSuite, Workato creates a new contact in NetSuite.
